newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover hits all-time high.

text.p: A special deal in first-tier fertilizer maker Azomures SA pushed Bucharest bourse turnover five times up from the previous session to all-time record 25.73 billion lei on Thursday, bourse officials said.

Investors rushed on the stock after the announcement of the deal involving over 9.5 million Azomures shares, pushing Azomures price 400 lei up to 2,500. It accounted for over 78 percent of bourse overall turnover.
Brokers said investors' interest continued to focus on the exchange's first-tier other three high-caps -- a chemical plant and two pharmaceutical firms -- whose prices rose amid active trading.
The Bucharest stock exchange, which opened in 1994, now trades 34 stocks, 30 of which are listed on the second tier. The previous high was on February 11, when turnover hit 6.34 billion lei.
Most small-caps edged up or stayed flat on Thursday. ($=7,082 lei)
